namespace PubAC07
def binom : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | _, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | n + 1, k + 1 => binom n k + binom n (k + 1)
theorem binom_gt_zero (n k : Nat) (h : n < k) : binom n k = 0 := by sorry
theorem binom_self (n : Nat) : binom n n = 1 := by sorry
theorem pascal_step (n k : Nat) : binom (n + 1) (k + 1) = binom n k + binom n (k + 1) := by sorry
end PubAC07
